wishboard.name: wishboard
wishboard.core_function_original:
Wishboard is where people post the things they want but can't find: a specific style, an out-of-stock item, a product that doesn't exist yet. Others +1 the requests they also want, comment, and share links to products that match. The best finds rise to the top.

For buyers, it's a way to get help finding something. For sellers and brands, it's a live demand board: every request shows how many people want it and where they are, so you can see what to make or stock before you build it.
